text.en:
The municipal district of Allacapan, Province of Cagayan, is converted into the municipality of
Allacapan, which shall comprise all the barrios and sitios now included in the territorial jurisdiction of said
municipal distict, except the sitios of Nararagan, Cabayu, Tolong, Silagan, Cabaggaoan, Luppiad and Batalim
which are transferred to the territoria; jurisdiction of the municipality of Ballesteros, Province of Cagayan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 15, 1945.
